meta.subject: Fix garbage writes locking up scratchpad pipeline

en.summary: Scratchpad write-scaling was fixed to ignore garbage local addresses so bogus accumulator writes do not lock the pipeline.
why_it_counts: Patch changes scratchpad and accumulator write-path RTL
The commit message describes a concrete pipeline lock-up bug
The added predicate blocks invalid garbage addresses before write scaling proceeds
evidence: Scratchpad.scala adds `!write_scale_q.io.deq.bits.laddr.is_garbage()` to the accumulator-scale enqueue condition
The affected logic sits in the write-scale to write-issue path
Only a central DUT RTL file is touched

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Special garbage or sentinel local addresses are often used internally to represent no-op writes, zero fills, or other control-only events. If an accumulator or scaled-write pipeline treats those sentinel addresses like real accumulator writes, it can request data from the wrong place or wait for a writeback that can never complete, wedging the scratchpad pipeline.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: garbage-address filtering before accumulator write scaling
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A write descriptor marked as accumulator-targeting also carries a sentinel or garbage local address.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Allow garbage-address descriptors to enter the accumulator scaling or write-issue pipeline as though they were normal writes.
portability_notes: Map this to any write pipeline stage that consumes accumulator or scratchpad addresses after a format conversion or scaling step.
The bug target is the validity filter on sentinel addresses, not the arithmetic of the scaler itself.
Another DUT may use a different invalid-address encoding, but the reinjection principle is to stop screening it out before the live pipeline stage.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the condition that decides whether a write descriptor may enter the accumulator-side scale or format-conversion stage.
Remove the guard that rejects garbage or sentinel local addresses.
Leave the accumulator-bank match and ready-valid checks intact so only the invalid-address case is reintroduced.
Inject a workload that emits sentinel-address writes into the accumulator-side path.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Accumulator write_scale_q dequeue condition in Scratchpad
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds !write_scale_q.io.deq.bits.laddr.is_garbage() before allowing write_scale_q entries into the accumulator scaling path.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Delete the !write_scale_q.io.deq.bits.laddr.is_garbage() term from the accumulator-side write_scale_q gating condition.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Garbage write descriptors can enter the accumulator write pipeline, causing scratchpad pipeline lockup or misrouted accumulator writes.
evidence_for_injection: The original failure is described as a scratchpad pipeline lockup caused by garbage writes.
The new condition is added exactly at the handoff into the accumulator scale path.
The rest of the gating stays the same, which makes the garbage-address filter the minimal faithful mutation target.
notes: This fault is most visible when internal sentinel addresses can reach the write_scale queue.
The faithful reverse mutation is simply to remove the added guard; no other part of the write pipeline needs to change.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 scratchpad 写缩放路径，使其忽略垃圾本地地址，从而避免伪造的 accumulator 写请求锁死流水线。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改了 scratchpad 与 accumulator 写路径 RTL
提交信息描述了明确的流水线锁死缺陷
新增条件会在写缩放之前阻止无效的垃圾地址
evidence: Scratchpad.scala 在 accumulator-scale 入队条件中增加了 `!write_scale_q.io.deq.bits.laddr.is_garbage()`
受影响逻辑位于 write-scale 到 write-issue 的路径上
只修改了核心 DUT RTL 文件

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 内部常常会用特殊的垃圾地址或哨兵地址来表示 no-op 写、零填充，或其他仅控制类事件。如果 accumulator 或缩放写流水线把这些哨兵地址当作真实的 accumulator 写来处理，就可能从错误位置取数，或者等待一个永远不会完成的写回，从而把 scratchpad 流水线卡死。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 进入 accumulator 写缩放前的垃圾地址过滤
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某个写描述符同时被标记为指向 accumulator，但其本地地址又是垃圾值或哨兵值。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 允许这些垃圾地址描述符像普通写请求一样进入 accumulator 缩放或写发射流水线。
portability_notes: 可映射到任何在格式转换或缩放之后继续消费 accumulator 或 scratchpad 地址的写流水级。
故障目标是过滤哨兵地址的有效性保护，而不是 scaler 本身的算术。
其他 DUT 也许使用不同的无效地址编码，但回注原则仍然是在进入活动流水级之前停止屏蔽它。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位决定写描述符是否可以进入 accumulator 侧缩放或格式转换阶段的条件。
删除拒绝垃圾或哨兵本地地址的保护项。
保留 accumulator bank 匹配和 ready-valid 检查，只重现无效地址这一情形。
注入能让哨兵地址写请求进入 accumulator 侧路径的工作负载。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Scratchpad 中 accumulator 侧的 write_scale_q 出队条件
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在允许 write_scale_q 条目进入 accumulator 缩放路径之前，增加了 !write_scale_q.io.deq.bits.laddr.is_garbage() 条件。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 从 accumulator 侧 write_scale_q 的 gating 条件中删除 !write_scale_q.io.deq.bits.laddr.is_garbage()。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 垃圾写描述符会进入 accumulator 写流水线，导致 scratchpad 流水线锁死，或把写入错误地路由到 accumulator。
evidence_for_injection: 原始故障被直接描述为由垃圾写引起的 scratchpad 流水线锁死。
新增条件恰好位于进入 accumulator scale 路径的交接点。
其余 gating 都保持不变，因此垃圾地址过滤就是最小且忠实的回注目标。
notes: 这个故障在内部哨兵地址能够到达 write_scale 队列时最容易暴露。
忠实的逆向注入只需要删除新增保护条件，不必修改写流水线的其他部分。
